title: Cosmic Braided Portrait
description: A close-up portrait of a young woman with large expressive eyes and a long thick braid decorated with stars and flowers. Her face is split into purple, orange, and white sections with intricate black line tattoos, while a red circular landscape symbol sits on her forehead.
prompt: Surreal close-up portrait of a young woman with large detailed eyes, her face divided into purple, orange and white color blocks with intricate black line-work tattoos and patterns. She has a very long thick black braid adorned with white stars and flowers, a red circular emblem on her forehead containing a tiny landscape scene, set against a background of stylized mountains, crystals, a mechanical creature on a platform, and a small explorer figure standing on a cliff.
